cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Access Has a Price
cards.instruction: Turn every piece of access, information, or approval into a favor, debt, or condition.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll unlock the storeroom if you cover my reception break.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Someone spilled coffee in the lobby. Just tell me where the mop is.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Behind the buckets. That's five minutes of cover; unlocking costs another ten.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lend me the key. I'll mop first, then cover your break.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The key costs tomorrow's break too. Today's cover pays for opening the door.

mechanism: A professionally separates information, door opening and key custody into priced access categories, each yielding extra break cover.
confusable: D46 prices favours generally; D70 specifically makes access, information or approval conditional even when B tries another route.
comparison: Curator alternative prices information and contact privileges; storeroom alternative prices location, door opening and key custody.
seedUse: Mop, lobby spill, break cover, storeroom and key derive from D70-a; S03 adds exact access-category correction.
